title: Sudhandhiram
desc: Vishwa, a thug and an aspiring boxer, works for Sopraj, a gangster. When Sopraj brutally kills a social worker in front of Vishwa, he decides to turn approver against his boss.

title: Chandramouli
desc: When a family is forced to leave a village on the Sri Lankan coast, a mother gets separated from her son. He fights against all odds, including his evil stepbrother, to meet his mother.

title: Cheran Pandian
desc: Periya Gounder, bound by caste pride, mistreats his stepbrother Chinna. However, when his daughter falls for Chinna's relative, his beliefs are challenged.

title: Jodi
desc: Kannan falls in love with Gayathri but both decide to win the hearts of each other's family members and marry with their consent.

title: Laththi Charge
desc: Muruganantham is ordered to assault Vellai for misbehaving with the Deputy's daughter. However, when Vellai's father Guna, a mafia king, learns of this, he unleashes his wrath on the former.
